summary.oneLiner: Gujarat-based B2B manufacturer of compact ring-spun cotton yarns and value-added yarns (Eli Twist, compact slub, Lycra-blended, organic) supplying textile manufacturers, garment exporters and bulk purchasers from a single spinning facility at Gondal, Rajkot.
summary.business: Shree Ram Twistex manufactures 100% cotton yarns - Compact Ring Spun and Carded Yarns (combed and carded) in counts Ne 8 to Ne 40 - plus value-added yarns such as Eli Twist (Siro) Ne 40/2, Compact Slub and Lycra-blended yarns, used in knitting and weaving for denim, terry towels, shirting, sheeting, sweaters, socks, bottom wear, home textiles and industrial fabrics. It operates exclusively B2B, selling to institutional buyers (textile manufacturers, garment exporters, bulk purchasers, fabric processors) via direct sales and a broker/agent network domestically, with opportunistic exports …
